slope_down_10.note: spawned 200 px up the plateau, so the walk left goes down the slope and back up it

slope_down_20.note: spawned 200 px up the plateau, so the walk left goes down the slope and back up it

slope_down_30.note: spawned 200 px up the plateau, so the walk left goes down the slope and back up it

slope_down_45.note: spawned 200 px up the plateau, so the walk left goes down the slope and back up it

slope_down_60.note: spawned 200 px up the plateau, so the walk left goes down the slope and back up it

slope_down_75.note: spawned 200 px up the plateau, so the walk left goes down the slope and back up it

step_up_48.note: a wall, not a step: pressing right stops at it by design, up climbs it

shelf_lip.note: walks off the shelf edge, round the lip onto the underside, and back

box.note: an enclosed box, all four walls

overhang_wedge.note: a ceiling slanting down to the floor: a dead end, the gecko must stop without dancing

overhang_shelf_under.note: a low shelf 76 px over the floor

ceiling_step_up.note: the ceiling recedes to the right: a convex corner upside down

ceiling_step_down.note: the ceiling comes down 24 px to the right: a step, upside down

tunnel_shaft.note: a 22 px shaft, spawned on its left wall

cliff_walk.note: the floor ends: the gecko wraps the edge, walks down the face and along the lower floor, then back up

pool.note: walk in, swim across, climb out on the far wall

pool_drop.note: a jump into deep water, then no input: floats in the top half of the pool, never the bottom

moss_wall.note: a wall coated with moss from 560 to 760: the climb reaches the coat and drops; it ends on the floor

moss_bitten.note: a wall with a coat of moss at its foot, one bite tall: the bite takes it and the climb goes on past it

notch_climb.note: the bare wall with the same bites at its foot: the climb out of the notch they leave, and on up

crumble_wall.note: a wall whose lower face crumbles after a second's hold: the climber comes down with it

pool_current.note: a pool running left at 230 px/s, faster than the swim's kick: a swim to the right gets nowhere

gas_pocket.note: a sealed pocket of gas under the floor: the dig down opens it and the burst throws the gecko up, its glow out

squeeze_low_12.note: a passage 12 px tall under a slab, squeezed through and back

squeeze_low_16.note: a passage 16 px tall under a slab, squeezed through and back

squeeze_slot_12.note: a 12 px slot in the floor entered with a down press, to the shaft floor below, and back out

squeeze_slot_16.note: a 16 px slot in the floor entered with a down press, to the shaft floor below, and back out

squeeze_door_12_12.note: a hole 12 px tall at the floor through a wall 12 px thick, squeezed through and back

squeeze_door_12_16.note: a hole 16 px tall at the floor through a wall 12 px thick, squeezed through and back

squeeze_door_24_12.note: a hole 12 px tall at the floor through a wall 24 px thick, squeezed through and back

squeeze_door_24_16.note: a hole 16 px tall at the floor through a wall 24 px thick, squeezed through and back

squeeze_window_12.note: a 12 px hole through a 12 px wall, 40 px above the floor: up the wall, a press into it enters the hole, out the far side

squeeze_ragged.note: a ragged chewed passage 11 to 20 px tall at floor level between two rooms, 160 px long

sand_bed.note: a bed of sand 64 px tall on the floor, then a trench of sand level with the floor on a plate of bedrock: walked over and back; sand_dig bites down into the trench and waits for the sand to pour in

sand_hopper.note: a hopper of sand in a rock block over a 32 px pocket, a 4 px plate under it: a bite up from the pocket's floor opens the plate, the sand pours over the gecko, which burrows out to the left

materials.note: every material in a row: a bed of sand, a bank of clay, a pool of water, a pool of lava (nothing to the gecko yet: it falls in and stands on the bottom), a block of hard rock, a block of bedrock, a vein of copper, a stone and a clump of clay, bedrock 160 px under the floor; the brush and the keys try them
